definitions.explanation: Coming after all others in time or order.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{最後|さいご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧か。
examples.english: Do you have any questions at the end?

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最後|さいご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泣|な}いた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: I cried at the end of the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最後|さいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: On the last day of the trip, we all took a photo together.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めないで→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Because I didn't give up and kept at it until the end, I was able to finish all the difficult problems.

notes:
{最後|さいご} means the last or final item in a sequence, or the end of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {最後|さいご}の〜: the last... ({最後|さいご}の{電車|でんしゃ} = last train)
- {最後|さいご}に: at the end, finally
- {最後|さいご}まで: until the end
- これが{最後|さいご}: this is the last (one)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {最後|さいご}まで{諦|あきら}めない: don't give up until the end
- {最後|さいご}の{最後|さいご}まで: until the very end

CONTRAST:
- {最後|さいご}: last, final ↔ {最初|さいしょ}: first, beginning
- {最後|さいご}: last ↔ {終|お}わり: end (the ending itself)

NOTE:
{最後|さいご} emphasizes position in sequence. For expressing something happening "for the last time," use {最後|さいご}に〜する.
